title: A chg landing on an independent path is held until it is independently verified

story.i_want_to: a change chg landed that touches an independent path to be held until a separated verifier on another host has verified it
story.so_that: a self-modifying change that reaches master through chg gets the same independent verification Gate B gives a pull-request merge (US-52.12)

rationale: US-52.12 makes Gate B clear an independent path only when MergePrecondition.independent_verification/2 is :ok, but that gate runs before loopctl merges a pull request; on the chg route chg lands the change and loopctl is told afterwards, through the landed event. US-52.12 left that route to this story because the hold must leave over US-52.31's holder resolve edge, not a human one (nothing waits for Mark, PRD R4). Split from US-52.31 so a defect in the chg landing path never blocks the holder-resolve change the rest of release 5 depends on.

acceptance_criteria.description: Applying a chg landed event of a story whose repo has independent_paths enqueues, inside the event's own transaction, one Loopctl.Workers.ChgIndependentPathsWorker job unique per (story_id, merge_sha), and changes nothing else: the landing is recorded and the item is merged exactly as today, and a redelivered landed event enqueues no second job.

The job reads the landed diff (PullRequestSource.compare/3) and escalates the item, under the story lock, from merged over the new control-only edge {:merged, :escalated, :independent_unverified} when the diff touches an independent path and MergePrecondition.independent_verification/2 (US-52.12) is not :ok for the landed revision, or when the diff cannot be read; when no independent path is touched, or the fact is :ok, it writes nothing.

:independent_unverified is control-only (absent from runner_reportable_edges and from every Spec's allowed transitions) and is held as a :review_missing escalation is: a holder resolution (US-52.31) of an item that entered escalated over it is refused 409 independent_verification, changing nothing, while independent_verification/2 is not :ok for the landed revision, and proceeds once it is; a human resolution is unaffected.

test_cases.name: a landed event enqueues one check and changes nothing else (DataCase, chg fixtures)
preconditions: a chg story with a recorded review (fixtures from test/loopctl/changes/review_custody_test.exs); triggers with independent_paths lib/gate/**
steps: apply the same landed event again
expected_results: the item is merged as today
one job with the story id and merge_sha

test_cases.name: the check escalates an unverified independent landing and nothing else (DataCase, PullRequestSourceMock)
preconditions: three merged chg stories: the mock compare for the first lists lib/gate/a.ex with no independent verifier; for the second lists lib/other.ex; for the third fails
expected_results: second still merged with no new event

test_cases.name: the hold leaves over the holder edge only once verified (DataCase)
preconditions: the first item of TC-52.31a.2 escalated over :independent_unverified; holder B
steps: record verification by a separated verifier on another runner with e2e green at the landed revision

technical_notes: chg route: the landed effect is EventEffects.after_move/5 for 'landed' (lib/loopctl/changes/event_effects.ex:564), where the :review_missing hold is taken through escalate_raw/5. The landed diff is a forge read (PullRequestSource.compare/3, pull_request_source.ex:384), so it is never made inside the event transaction: the landed effect enqueues the job in that transaction, and the job reads the diff, runs Gate B with the repo's independent_paths, and escalates under the story lock when the fact is not :ok.

Stage machine: {:merged, :escalated, :independent_unverified} joins @transitions (lib/loopctl/delivery/stage_machine.ex:286) beside the @release_escalations-style control-only reasons, and Stages.advance/4 refuses it from any caller but the job (the @release_only_edges pattern, stages.ex:2114).
Hold: the refusal runs in Escalations.resolve/3's pre-release block (US-52.31) beside the review_missing check (AC-52.31.5), so a refused resolve destroys nothing (the #862 rule).
independent_verification/2 and Gate B's :independent outcome are provided by US-52.12; the holder resolve edge and its pre-release block by US-52.31.
non_goals: A chg-side check before chg lands: loopctl judges the landing it is told about (US-52.12 non-goals).
Changing how a pull-request merge is gated: US-52.12.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.31a.1: the job is enqueued in the landed event's own transaction, so a landing that commits always carries its check, and an Oban job survives a lost connection to the forge by retrying.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.31a.1: the check is an Oban job row in loopctl's Postgres and the hold is a stage event; a restart or deploy loses neither.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.31a.1: the job is unique per story and merge_sha, so a redelivered landed event or a retried job escalates at most once.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.31a.2: the forge read runs in the job, outside chg's event apply, so a slow forge never holds a landing; a diff that cannot be read escalates rather than passing.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.31a.1: the job runs on any loopctl node through Oban and reaches the item by its story id.

definition_of_done: On production, a chg-landed change touching an independent path with no separated verifier shows an :independent_unverified escalation on its timeline, and a holder's resolve is refused until the verification is recorded.
defaults: A landed diff that cannot be read escalates (fail closed).
